title: Congruence mod n is transitive on the integers
statement: For all integers n, a, b and c: if a is congruent to b modulo n and b is congruent to c modulo n, then a is congruent to c modulo n.

formal.statement: theorem Int.modEq_trans : ((x0 : Int) -> ((x1 : Int) -> ((x2 : Int) -> ((x3 : Int) -> ((x4 : Int.ModEq x0 x1 x2) -> ((x5 : Int.ModEq x0 x2 x3) -> Int.ModEq x0 x1 x3))))))
